Apply only to NS-000049, organization SEA, and CASE-049. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

Internal timing comes from governance review window; external timing is conditional on supplier closure evidence. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.

messages.text: Procurement leadership needs one defensible decision for supplier remediation PO by 2026-01-15; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside all CAPA deliverables and financial documents must be complete.
I found 14225.25 USD on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0049 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000049 up to 14225.25 USD, provided all CAPA deliverables and financial documents must be complete. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or leave_settled_po_open.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for governance review window is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R9 and the CASE-050 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-049.

Required closeout records: prepare the reply in the existing email thread and leave it as a draft for review; do not send it; and record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
